dvids.title: John Finn Prepares Lunch
dvids.desc: A U.S. Sailor carves a turkey while preparing lunch in the galley aboard Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS John Finn (DDG 113), Nov. 16, 2026. John Finn is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations to support maritime security and stability in the Middle East. (U.S. Navy video
